text:
The review is written, with verdict `fix`: six findings that must change and three notes. I read the brief, the diff and the cards, and spot-checked the cited code lines. I did not re-run any of the measurements.

The main gaps:
- **Naming rule:** the posted card says the folder name is the card's existing id, but `recursive-pages.md` section 6 says it is a slug of the title. The two contradict each other.
- **Trigger has no hook:** the proposal puts the promotion check in `apply_pages()` (`Servex/agents/page_tools.js:414`), but that function refuses any call that has a target (line 413).
- **Measurements incomplete:** the brief asked for deepest level and time to first render per URL. The doc table has only files and size, and `/live/design/` is missing from it.
- **No record to check against:** the task folder has no measurement artifact, only one log line and the cards. A fresh agent can't re-run or verify the 168, 118 and 31 file counts.
- **Request count unclear:** the log says the synthetic tree showed 37 requests, 6 of them duplicate root re-fetches. The doc says only "31 of 156" without that detail.
- **Not indexed:** `core/Page/readme.md:82` still describes `recursive-pages.md` as the "every card a page" doc. The new sections aren't mentioned there or in `index-jsonl.md`.

The notes: the `LivePage.save()` correction is right, the 16 MB extrapolation for 1000 flat children is linear from one measured folder rather than measured, and the code fence held.

The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/06/spawned/mastermind-page-design/storage/review.md`.
